title: ArcCivs Auto mine safe fallback at the existing generator rate
assumptions: Only PHYSICAL Auto quarries with a real pickaxe and safe, loaded, unlocked, unclaimed own storage stance qualify. Ordinary mines and legacy virtual Auto do not receive fallback.

One exclusive roll per observed 6000ms work session: 95 percent COBBLESTONE, 4 percent COAL, 1 percent RAW_IRON with a suitable tool; an unsuitable iron roll returns COBBLESTONE. This assessment assumes an iron-capable pickaxe.

Low/base/high assume 150/600/2400 fallback rolls per city-player-day, 0.25/1/4 active hours at the ideal ceiling of 600 rolls/hour, and 1/10/16 cities with one miner each. These are bounded sensitivity scenarios, not measured runtime throughput.

Before values describe the same blocked physical branch: zero production. The existing fully built generator already has the same 6000ms and 95/4/1 rate. Ordinary native excavation is up to 1800 two-second actions/hour before travel, support, sleep, supplies and meals; it is an alternative activity and is not added to fallback income.

One existing tool use per fallback receipt including existing Unbreaking and break semantics. Production accumulates in real resident slots, remains limited by bag capacity and ordinary courier/storage transfer, requires real observed arrival/work time, and uses the existing city revision/cycle and inventory journal. Recovery does not roll again.

Physical discovery receives at most sixteen owner admissions before one fallback work session; a completed persistent refusal can choose it earlier. The physical cursor and predecessor proof are not advanced. Native changes/protection changes reopen branch denials.

No direct Vault, tokens or player XP changes; no invented money exchange for items. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL/AutoSell remains a separate downstream flow; the owner planned SELL-to-contract transition remains a separate future scenario and no contracts are assumed active.

At 24 active hours the action ceiling is 14400 rolls/account/day; 95/4/1 expectation is 13680 cobble, 576 coal and 144 raw iron. Multiaccount issuance scales with eligible loaded/staffed cities; no new global item budget exists. Actual search, travel, meals, night, worn tools and finite storage lower this ceiling.

No price/progression-cost changes, so saving time for a monetary purchase is unknown and not modeled. Purchase-processing-sale arbitrage cannot be quantified without verified current SELL prices and is not claimed zero. No native ore is removed or double counted by fallback.
